change: Nuclear preference now requires uranium, conversion, enrichment, HALEU or alternative fuel, and fuel-contract traceability.
Advanced fuel, TRISO, fabrication, qualification and QA became binding gates, not optional technical notes.
Spent-fuel storage, dry-cask integrity, interim/repository pathway, transport and backend consent now cap maturity.
Safeguards, material accountancy, export-control and transport security now separate public auditability from sensitive disclosure.
Fuel-cycle and backend gaps now appear in gate evaluations, traceability, gap backlog and scorecards.
